newsitem.title: USA: Oct U.S. MTBE stocks up 4.9 percent to 8.77 mln
newsitem.headline: Oct U.S. MTBE stocks up 4.9 percent to 8.77 mln

text.p: U.S. inventories of MTBE rose in October by 4.93 percent to 8.77 million barrels amid a stock build in the West Coast and draws in the East and Gulf Coasts, according to U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) data.
The report, released Thursday by the DOE's U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), also said output of MTBE rose by about 0.54 percent to 187,000 barrels per day (bpd).
Stocks in the key U.S. Gulf output region fell 9.55 percent or 328,000 barrels to 3.106 million barrels, while USG output rose 3 percent to 169,000 barrels.

East Coast inventories eased 98,000 barrels to 1.19 million barrels. Output in the key consumption region, where reformulated gasoline use is concentrated, was not provided in order to protect individual company data, EIA said.
West Coast inventories rose 24.2 percent to 4.15 million barrels, with output data in the region also witheld.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk 212 859-1631
